title: From idea to
description: 5 clear steps — no chaos, hidden phases or unnecessary stress. You always know where we stand.

steps.title: Getting acquainted
steps.description: You write to me via a convenient messenger — tell me about your business, task and target audience. I listen and ask the right questions.

steps.title: Briefing & script
steps.description: I structure the idea: concept, script, moodboard and a clear shooting plan. Everything is agreed with you.

steps.title: Shoot day
steps.description: I come to you or we choose a location. Sound, light, image — every detail is controlled.

steps.title: Editing & post-production
steps.description: I tell the story: editing, graphics, music and colour grading. Every second counts.

steps.title: Final & revisions
steps.description: I present the result, refine details based on your feedback and deliver the final file in any format.
